documentation.xhtml: Sequencer states for FB_CabinetSetpointControl - write -> confirm -> latch flow of a single supervisory setpoint change to the Watlow F4S over Modbus.
Single, prioritised fault/warning code surfaced to the HMI so the operator sees a clear reason when a setpoint change is refused or the link is unhealthy.

Channel-mapped raw variables that the CODESYS Modbus Serial Master channels wire onto (I/O Mapping tab). Port /dev/ttyUSB0, 19200 8N1, slave address 1 (F4S). See codesys-modbus-integration/README.md Part 3C/4.
FC03 cyclic read, offset 100 (fallback 99), length 1 -> actual temp raw (x10)
FC03 read-back, offset 300 (fallback 299), length 1 -> SP1 raw read (x10)
FC06 write single register, offset 300 -> SP1 raw write (x10)
Rising-edge trigger var for the FC06 channel (I/O Mapping tab)
Every tag the WebVisu screen binds to. Gear button opens a pop-up (dlgSetpoint) bound to rReqSetpoint / xSetBtn / xResetBtn. See codesys-modbus-integration/README.md.

Supervisory setpoint control for the Left Hand Small Temperature Cabinet (Watlow F4S, Modbus RTU / RS-232). Reads/writes GVL_Modbus and GVL_HMI directly in its body per the Project Development Package spec - see the .st source header for the known follow-up note on this coupling.
Cyclic entry point (MainTask). xOverTempDI is wired to GVL_Modbus.xModbusError as a placeholder - REPLACE with the real mapped EL1409 digital-input channel before relying on this interlock.
